measurementLimits: Retained 60 + 14 + 13 = 87 windows; zero replacements, so the expected counter is 87 minus zero.
The four IME windows add exactly 2000ms of requested observation per full run.
Per-issue target sets overlap: transport and wheel/IME each cover the same ten scene cases; terminal/history adds three snapshots. Do not sum their case/command costs.
File runner time minus summed case bodies is hooks/cleanup/runner remainder, not a directly sampled setup hook. Shared invocation build is separately measured.
The untouched first control has no per-site counters; the matched before/after pair uses identical per-site instrumentation.
Sequential single pairs on a shared host; unrelated load, network scheduling and storage latency are uncontrolled. No local or CI saving/critical-path claim.
Chosen margins supply bounded operational opportunities. They are not measured universal IO bounds or mathematically minimal durations.
Complete selected hosted candidate proof and merge belong to the coordinator; this study is local native proof.
